_comment: Hidden answer key for the review-planted fixture. NEVER copied into the run workspace. Each bug is located by `anchors` (exact code text); `line` is the first anchor's line and is re-derived from the anchors by the unit tests, so an edit to the fixture that moves a bug fails the tests instead of silently mis-scoring. A finding matches a bug when it cites the same file at a line within `window` of any anchor line.

bugs.description: Slice end is start + size - 1, so every page drops its last item.

anchors: def tags_for(sku: str, extra: List[str] = []) -> List[str]:
bugs.description: Mutable default list is appended to, so tags leak between calls.
Validity check is inverted: expired tokens are valid and fresh ones are not.
Non-admins may delete any order; admins only their own (condition inverted).
E-mail is interpolated into SQL with %, allowing SQL injection; use a ? parameter.
Conversion cache is keyed by sku only, so the first currency's price is returned for every currency.
OSError is swallowed and save_order still returns True, reporting success for a failed write.
User-supplied filename is joined unchecked, so ../ or an absolute path escapes EXPORT_ROOT.
